author: nickyeow

english.text: Sometimes it's good for a married couple to go to a hot spring together—just the two of them.

jyutping: loeng5 gung1 po2 jing1 goi1 dak1 haan4 heoi3 zam3 wan1 cyun4，gwo3 haa5 ji6 jan4 sai3 gaai3。
text: 兩公婆應該得閒去浸溫泉，過吓二人世界。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She loves watching tennis matches on TV.

jyutping: keoi5 hou3 zung1 ji3 hai2 din6 si6 dou6 tai2 mong5 kau4 bei2 coi3。
text: 佢好鍾意喺電視度睇網球比賽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: With the approach of Christmas, business improved somewhat.

jyutping: sing3 daan3 zit3 zau6 faai3 dou3，saang1 ji3 dou1 hou2 zo2 di1。
text: 聖誕節就快到，生意都好咗啲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Does Tom have to stay home today?

jyutping: aa3 Tom gam1 jat6 sai2 m4 sai2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 aa3？
text: 阿 Tom 今日使唔使留喺屋企呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Mother insists that we should be home by seven in the evening.

jyutping: aa3 maa1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 hai2 je6 maan5 cat1 dim2 zi1 cin4 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2。
text: 阿媽一定要我哋喺夜晚七點之前返到屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I think he'll never return.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 keoi5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4 gaa3 laa3。
text: 我諗佢永遠都唔會返嚟㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't bother me with such foolish questions.

jyutping: m4 hou2 man6 maai4 di1 gam3 ngong6 geoi1 ge3 man6 tai4 lai4 faan4 ngo5 laa1。
text: 唔好問埋啲咁戇居嘅問題嚟煩我啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My watch loses three minutes a week.

jyutping: ngo5 zek3 biu1 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 maan6 saam1 fan1 zung1。
text: 我隻錶每個禮拜慢三分鐘。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You should study harder.

jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 nou5 lik6 di1 duk6 syu1。
text: 你應該努力啲讀書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The cottage looked as if nobody were living in it.

jyutping: gaan1 uk1 zai2 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 mou5 jan4 zyu6 gam2。
text: 間屋仔睇落好似冇人住噉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Twenty thousand yen, please.

jyutping: ji6 maan6 jyun4 aa1 m4 goi1。
text: 二萬円吖唔該。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you watch TV last night?

jyutping: nei5 cam4 maan5 jau5 mou5 tai2 din6 si6 aa3？
text: 你尋晚有冇睇電視呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll write you as soon as I arrive there.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 heoi3 dou3 zau6 wui5 se2 seon3 bei2 nei5 gaa3 laa3。
text: 我一去到就會寫信俾你㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It has started to rain.

jyutping: hoi1 ci2 lok6 jyu5 laa3。
text: 開始落雨喇。

author: cc_neko

english.text: We'll be friends forever.

jyutping: jau5 ji4 wing5 gu3。
text: 友誼永固。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I know nothing about music.

jyutping: jam1 ngok6 ge3 je5 ngo5 zan1 hai6 sik1 tiu4 mou4。

english.text: She said happily, "Good morning, everybody!"

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam3 waa6：daai6 gaa1 zou2 san4 aa3！
text: 佢好開心咁話：大家早晨呀！

author: nickyeow

english.text: "When is her birthday?" - "I have no idea. Why don't you ask her yourself?"

jyutping: 「keoi5 gei2 si4 saang1 jat6 gaa3？」「nei5 man6 ngo5，ngo5 man6 bin1 go3 aa3？nei5 m4 zi6 gei2 man6 keoi5？」
text: 「佢幾時生日㗎？」「你問我，我問邊個呀？你唔自己問佢？」

author: kaenif

english.text: I have a sore throat.

jyutping: ngo5 hau4 lung4 tung3。
text: 我喉嚨痛。

author: sgmw

english.text: Tom and Mary grew up in Boston.

jyutping: aa3 Tom tung4 aa3 Mary hai6 hai2 bo1 si6 deon2 daai6 ge3。
text: 阿Tom同阿Mary係喺波士頓大嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The company is in deficit.

jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 gan2 cin4。
text: 間公司蝕緊錢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He was trying so hard that he turned red.

jyutping: keoi5 ceot1 zeon6 cyun4 lik6，lin4 faai3 min6 dou1 hung4 maai4。
text: 佢出盡全力，連塊面都紅埋。

author: kaenif

english.text: Are you sure there wasn't some kind of misunderstanding?

jyutping: nei5 hang2 ding6 jat1 di1 ng6 wui6 dou1 mou5？
text: 你肯定一啲誤會都冇？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom was sitting under a tree, drinking wine.

jyutping: aa3 Tom zo6 zo2 hai2 fo2 syu6 haa6 min6 jam2 pou4 tou4 zau2。
text: 阿Tom坐咗喺棵樹下面飲葡萄酒。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is through hard work that he succeeded, not through good luck.

jyutping: keoi5 sing4 gung1 hai6 kaau3 nou5 lik6，m4 hai6 kaau3 coi2 sou3。
text: 佢成功係靠努力，唔係靠彩數。

english.text: The Sultan's Palace and the ancient Hippodrome are also places of great interest. In the latter were deposited the four gilded bronze horses, supposed to have been brought from Scio, once mounted on Trajan's Arch at Rome, brought here by Constantine. They were taken to Venice by Dandolo, then Napoleon gave them to Paris, and finally after Waterloo they were restored again to St. Mark's at Venice.

text: 蘇丹宮同古代馬場亦都係好有趣嘅地方。喺後者入面存放咗四隻鍍金嘅青銅馬，應該係由西奧帶嚟嘅，曾經裝喺羅馬嘅圖拉真拱門上面，由康斯坦丁帶嚟呢度。佢哋由丹多羅帶去威尼斯，然後拿破崙將佢哋交畀巴黎，最後喺滑鐵盧之後，佢哋又被恢復返到威尼斯嘅聖馬可教堂。

english.text: When Cinder-Maid went to the ball the Prince would dance with none but her; and when midnight came round she fled as before. But the Prince, hoping to prevent her running away, had ordered the soldiers at the foot of the stair-case to pour out honey on the stairs so that her shoes would stick in it. But Cinder-Maid leaped from stair to stair and got away just in time.

text: 當灰姑娘去到個舞會嗰陣，除咗佢之外，王子唔會同佢一齊跳舞；而當午夜嚟到，佢就好似以前噉逃走 喺樓梯上面倒蜂蜜，等佢對鞋黐住喺度，但係灰姑娘就由樓梯跳到樓梯，啱啱好走咗。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Since the tragic upshot of our visit to Devonshire he had been engaged in two affairs of the utmost importance, in the first of which he had exposed the atrocious conduct of Colonel Upwood in connection with the famous card scandal of the Nonpareil Club, while in the second he had defended the unfortunate Mme. Montpensier from the charge of murder which hung over her in connection with the death of her step-daughter, Mlle. Carére, the young lady who, as it will be remembered, was found six months later alive and married in New York.

text: 自從我哋去德文郡嘅悲劇結果之後，佢就搞咗兩件最重要嘅事務，其中第一件事係佢揭露咗阿普伍德上校喺無與倫比俱樂部嘅著名牌醜聞中嘅殘忍行為，而第二件事就係佢為不幸嘅女士辯護。蒙潘西埃因為同佢繼女 Mlle 嘅死亡有關嘅殺人罪名而掛喺佢身上。卡雷，呢位年輕嘅女士，正如我哋會記得嘅，佢喺半年後被發現仲再生，並喺紐約結埋婚。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A hot, sunny, blue-sky day is today, the 16th of July of 2025, here on Lulu Island. As usual, I walk several times to Tim Hortons café for drinks and snacks. Today was my 70th time this year to the "Clam Temple," the Roman Catholic church at St. Albans Road. There were Polish workers doing something with the big wooden doors. I love Science, though I'm a spiritual Syncretist. At the Bamboo Grove, rose leaves littered the compost, full of fragrant rotting apples. Yesterday, the 15th, at the café, after a long time, I saw my Filipina friend Alma, an ex-worker at 7-Eleven, with her already teenage son. Then, also at the café, I saw the familiar father and daughter, who are Tahitians from New Zealand. The girl wore a pale yellow-orange hibiscus flower on her right ear. Then, I saw the familiar big Japanese-looking man mending his beige shorts at the café: "Chabacano!" he whispered. I've been eating lots of tofu lately at home.

jyutping: gam1 jat6，2025 nin4 7 jyut6 16 hou6，hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2，hai6 jat1 go3 jim4 jit6、cing4 long5、laam4 tin1 ge3 jat6 zi2。ngo5 tung4 ping4 si4 jat1 joeng6，haang4 zo2 gei2 ci3 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 je5 tung4 sik6 siu2 sik6。gam1 jat6 hai6 ngo5 gam1 nin4 dai6 70 ci3 heoi3「gap3 lei4 miu2」，zik1 hai6 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2。jau5 di1 bo1 laan4 gung1 jan4 jung6 di1 daai6 muk6 mun4 zou6 gan2 di1 je5。ngo5 zung1 ji3 fo1 hok6，seoi1 jin4 ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 zing1 san4 soeng6 ge3 jung4 hap6 zyu2 ji6 ze2。hai2 zuk1 syu6 lam4，mui4 gwai3 jip6 saan3 lok6 hai2 deoi1 fei4 soeng6 min6，jap6 min6 cung1 mun5 zo2 hoeng1 nung4 ge3 fu6 laan6 ping4 gwo2。kam4 jat6 ge3 15 hou6，hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2，ging1 gwo3 hou2 noi6 zi1 hau6，ngo5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5 Alma ，keoi5 hai6 7-11 ge3 cin4 gung1 jan4，tung4 keoi5 go3 ji5 ging1 sap6 gei2 seoi3 ge3 zai2。jin4 hau6，jik6 dou1 hai6 hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 gin3 dou2 go2 deoi3 suk6 sik1 ge3 fu6 neoi5，keoi5 dei6 hai6 lai4 zi6 nau2 sai1 laan4 ge3 daai6 kai1 dei6 jan4。 go3 neoi5 zai2 hai2 keoi5 jau6 ji5 dou6 daai3 zyu6 jat1 do2 daam6 wong4 caang2 sik1 ge3 fu4 jung4 faa1。jin4 hau6，ngo5 gin3 dou2 go3 suk6 sik1 ge3 jat6 bun2 jan4 joeng6 ge3 daai6 naam4 jan2 hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2 dou6 zing2 gan2 keoi5 tiu4 mai5 sik1 dyun2 fu3：「Chabacano！」keoi5 sai3 sai3 seng1 gam2 gong2。
text: 今日，2025年7月16號，喺露露島，係一個炎熱、晴朗、藍天嘅日子。我同平時一樣，行咗幾次去 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳飲嘢同食小食。今日係我今年第70次去「蛤蜊廟」，即係聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂。有啲波蘭工人用啲大木門做緊啲嘢。我鍾意科學，雖然我係一個精神上嘅融合主義者。喺竹樹林，玫瑰葉散落喺堆肥上面，入面充滿咗香濃嘅腐爛蘋果。琴日嘅15號，喺咖啡館，經過好耐之後，我見到我嘅菲律賓朋友 Alma ，佢係7-11嘅前工人，同佢個已經十幾歲嘅仔。然後，亦都係喺咖啡館，我見到嗰對熟悉嘅父女，佢哋係嚟自紐西蘭嘅大溪地人。 個女仔喺佢右耳度戴住一朵淡黃橙色嘅芙蓉花。然後，我見到個熟悉嘅日本人樣嘅大男人喺咖啡館度整緊佢條米色短褲：「Chabacano！」佢細細聲噉講。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: If governments impose green tax hikes and the costly measures on transportation, home heating, power generation and lifestyles that scientists say are needed to lower emissions and to shift economies away from dependency on fossil fuels, they risk prompting a backlash, largely from middle-class and lower-income workers, as well as pensioners who can ill afford to bear the expense.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 deoi3 gaau1 tung1、gaa1 ting4 gung1 nyun5、faat3 din6 tung4 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1 sat6 si1 ngong4 gwai3 ge3 cou3 si1，fo1 hok6 gaa1 waa6 ni1 di1 cou3 si1 hai6 wai6 zo2 gong3 dai1 paai4 fong3 tung4 maai4 zoeng1 ging1 zai3 zyun2 ji4 lei4 hoi1 deoi3 faa3 sek6 jin4 liu2 ge3 ji1 laai6 so2 seoi1 jiu3 ge3，gam2 zau6 jau5 ho2 nang4 jan5 hei2 faan2 daan6，ni1 di1 faan2 jing3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 loi4 zi6 zung1 caan2 gaai1 kap1 tung4 dai1 sau1 jap6 gung1 jan4，tung4 maai4 fu6 daam1 m4 dou3 ni1 bat1 fai3 jung6 ge3 teoi3 jau1 jan4 si6。
text: 如果政府對交通、家庭供暖、發電同生活方式實施昂貴嘅措施，科學家話呢啲措施係為咗降低排放同埋將經濟轉移離開對化石燃料嘅依賴所需要嘅，噉就有可能引起反彈，呢啲反應主要係來自中產階級同低收入工人，同埋負擔唔到呢筆費用嘅退休人士。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Gordo, a squirrel monkey, was catapulted 600 miles high in a Jupiter rocket, also on December 13, 1958, one year after the Soviets launched Laika. Gordo's capsule was never found in the Atlantic Ocean. He died on splashdown when a flotation mechanism failed, but Navy doctors said signals on his respiration and heartbeat proved humans could withstand a similar trip.

text: 松鼠猴戈爾多被木星火箭彈射到600英里高，亦都係喺1958年12月13號，即係蘇聯發射萊卡一年之後。戈多嘅膠囊從來都冇喺大西洋發現過。佢因為浮動機制失效而死於潑水，但海軍醫生話佢呼吸同心跳嘅訊號證明人類可以頂住類似嘅行程。
